"The Canadian Pacific Railway is the premier trans-continental railway of Canada, stretching 7,050 kilometers across the breadth of North America. Constructed between 1881 and 1885, the railway connects Montreal and Quebec City on the St. Lawrence River and Atlantic seaboard in the east with Vancouver on the Pacific Ocean in the west. The line was originally built as a political commitment to bring British Columbia into the Canadian Federation.
